instrument.oracle: pre-launch route, payload and counter snapshot; exact payload sets per expert reservation interval, untouched-zero and final-count invariants

input_domain.required: every pre-launch half-open reservation interval fits within the destination capacity
input_domain.enforcement: the independent oracle checks this condition before launch and refuses an out-of-domain input

environment.preflight: One CPU-only process using exactly these paths must import Torch 2.13.0+cu130, Triton 3.7.1, Cutlass 4.7.0 and cutlass.cute, load the released Compiler, and confirm the selected Schedule lowers to the selected entry point before broker submission.

acceptance.required: the released generated source compiles and launches once on B200; each expert's reserved interval contains exactly its routed non-zero payload identities as an unordered set, every untouched destination slot stays zero, and final counters equal initial counters plus valid reservations
acceptance.failure: retain the first result or pre-launch failure; do not retry, change inputs, weaken the exact-set oracle, or rewrite this plan
acceptance.non_claim: does not establish performance, complete KDA-version expressibility, route or group formation, vector-row dispatch, reduction scatter, degree-one direct-store selection, a runtime capacity relation, end-to-end MoE correctness, ranking quality or paper reproduction
